assign.outcome:
**14 render variants to 6 — steps 2-5 of the demo-merge landed.** `demo(fn)`, `page.demo()`, `mini()`, and three engines (`stage`, `demo.app`, `layout.bar`). 231 call sites moved onto one shell by changing four files.

![](exhibit-1920.png)

**Deleted** — `two.js`, `two.css`, `demo.stage.two()`, `two()`, `twin()`, and `source_details()`, the `<details>` every caller reopened with `.attr("open","")`. `twin.js` became [pane.js](/framework/ext/demo/files/), which is the one live thing in it. Net -176 lines *including* ~200 lines of new docs; `exhibit.css` went 93 to 27.

**One code surface** — `source_block()` serves `demo.source()`, `demo.source.file()` and `page.demo()`'s peer column, with the copy button on all three (proved headless: 544 / 3138 / 804 chars copied).

**One demo UX** — [`page.demo()`](/framework/ext/demo/shell/) draws every demo page now; `demo.exhibit/page/tree/layout` are `children:` factories over it. Two new options: `run:` (a sugar hands in its own stage) and `bar:` (the layout bar). `demo.app()` prints its own width readout, which closes the 45 boxes that had none.

**Verified** — ~87 headless loads at 400 / 1920 / 3440. Every demo renders, render >= content, readout present, code beside at wide and below at 400, zero console errors. Palette wall 29/29, generator unregressed.

**Name clash** — kept `page.demo()`; demoted `demo.page()` from a render to a factory over it, so the two names no longer name two mechanisms. The cosmetic rename `demo.page` to `demo.fn` is 35 files of sed, outside this task's fence.

**Left** — `demo.source`/`.file` were NOT deleted outright: the proposal costed that at "22 sites", it is **19 separate files** (`core/Page/overview/` x8, `styles/layouts/` x2, `/web/` x9), past the fence. The names survive as two-line doors into the one block, which is all deleting them would have bought. Also left: `twin:` as a config word on 25 layout pages (it now means "the specimen paints its own ground"), and the `web/nav/*` preview-card crop, which is Page.css's `--thumb-max` thumbnail crop, not a demo height.
